meta.name: Pixel Platformer
meta.description: A playable pixel-art platformer level built on PopCraft's game physics: each layer has a role in its Game section (player, solid, one-way platform, collectible, hazard, goal, on-screen button, win banner), and the screen plays as a real game in Present mode and on a published site. Run with the arrows or A/D, jump with Space, collect the coins and reach the flag.
